service_name: WSG Careers Connect — Career Matching Services
rich_description: Careers Connect is Workforce Singapore's free career-coaching and job-matching service for locals who are looking for a new job, switching careers, or trying to get back into work after a long break. A career coach sits down with you to understand your work history, what kind of roles you can realistically take, what skills you may need to pick up, and then matches you to real openings on MyCareersFuture or to a Career Conversion Programme. It is especially used by mid-career workers who kena retrench, fresh jobseekers who are stuck, and caregivers or housewives returning to the workforce. Coaches can also point you to short SkillsFuture courses, salary support schemes, and interview preparation workshops in the same building. Walk in, book online, or just talk to the counter — the help is meant to lower the activation cost of starting a job search again.

other_criteria: Open to anyone seeking new employment, career change, or back-to-work pathways

required_documents.name: Updated resume
required_documents.notes: Coach can also help draft one if you don't have it

required_documents.name: Highest academic or training certificate
required_documents.notes: Optional but useful for skill matching

typical_processing_time: First coaching session typically within 1-2 weeks of registration; job matches are ongoing.
